title: The research lint flags a fact that states a read date its cited source row does not record
goal: researched or the contract lint refuses a fact that says a source was read or checked on a date later than that source row's retrieved_utc and dated notes, so a research story advances the row it re-read; found in the SP-7ff7c5ui review: claude/ci-and-headless.md:108 says the changelog was read on 2026-10-13 while S1864 still says 2026-10-12 (BG-4gwcjwno)

run:
import sys, os, csv, subprocess, tempfile
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import kbroot, kbcommon, build_index
d = os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(), 'mt')
os.makedirs(os.path.join(d, kbcommon.DATA_DIR))
files = {kbcommon.ROOT_FILE: kbroot.root_md('mt', 'MT', 'internal', 'planted'), kbcommon.COVERAGE_MD: '# Coverage' + chr(10) + build_index.START + chr(10) + build_index.END + chr(10)}
files.update((k, v.format(name='mt')) for k, v in kbroot.FILES.items())
for rel, text in files.items():
    open(os.path.join(d, rel), 'w', encoding='utf-8', newline='').write(text)
with open(os.path.join(d, kbcommon.SOURCES), 'a', encoding='utf-8', newline='') as f:
    csv.writer(f, lineterminator=chr(10)).writerow(['MT-aaaaaaaa', 'https://example.com/changelog', 'Changelog', 'Example', 'MIT', 'link', '2026-10-12', '', '', 'mt/dom/art;mt/dom/ctl', ''])
def article(name, day):
    os.makedirs(os.path.join(d, 'dom'), exist_ok=True)
    nl = chr(10)
    body = '---' + nl + 'topic: dom/' + name + nl + 'priority: P3' + nl + 'sources: [MT-aaaaaaaa]' + nl + 'status: complete' + nl + '---' + nl * 2
    body += '# T' + nl * 2 + '## Summary' + nl + 'x' + nl * 2 + '## Facts' + nl + '- The changelog was read on ' + day + ' and lists the new flag in its entries. [DOC MT-aaaaaaaa]' + nl * 2 + '## Reference' + nl + 'x' + nl * 2 + '## Examples' + nl + 'x' + nl
    open(os.path.join(d, 'dom', name + '.md'), 'w', encoding='utf-8').write(body)
article('art', '2026-10-13')
article('ctl', '2026-10-12')
env = dict(os.environ, KB_ROOTS=d)
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '.claude/skills/kb-verify/lint.py', 'mt/dom/art.md', 'mt/dom/ctl.md'], capture_output=True, text=True, env=env, timeout=25)
print(p.stdout[-800:], p.stderr[-300:])
hit = [l for l in p.stdout.splitlines() if 'art.md' in l and ('retrieved' in l or '2026-10-12' in l)]
miss = [l for l in p.stdout.splitlines() if 'ctl.md' in l and ('retrieved' in l or '2026-10-12' in l)]
sys.exit(0 if hit and not miss else 1)
